anomalies.observed: R60 pin2 is on ESTOP_OUT, and D30 pin4 (A2) is also on ESTOP_OUT. D30 pin2 (K2) connects only through R60 to ESTOP_OUT, so the ESTOP indicator LED has no ground return.

anomalies.expected: For isolated CAN buses, GND1 and GND2 should be separate nets, and VCC2 should be supplied from an isolated 5V source with its own isolated ground.

anomalies.impact: Galvanic isolation is defeated; the CAN buses are not isolated, which can cause ground loops and damage in the intended isolated environment.
